reuse.why: Writes its own #fixed regex instead of the existing extractTagsFromText in #shared/tags, and computes last month's spending with a new raw transactions SQL instead of the sheet's existing 'sum-amount-<category>' values that getCategoryAverage already reads.

duplication.why: The three average queries collapse into getFillableCategories, but copyPreviousMonth re-applies the hidden, template and #fixed rules itself, and setLastMonthSpending repeats the income-outside-tracking check and the expense sign inversion.

placement.why: Category selection sits in budget/actions.ts with the actions, but spending aggregation is done with ad hoc SQL over transactions in the budget actions module rather than through the budget sheet layer the other actions use.

scope.why: Only the four requested behaviours, the new method registration and release notes are touched.

maintainability.why: The month-wide rule is split between getFillableCategories (SQL hidden filter plus JS filters) and copyPreviousMonth's own checks, and the custom tag regex and spending query can drift from the app's tag parsing and sheet totals.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth decides eligibility itself instead of using getFillableCategories; isFixedGroup bypasses extractTagsFromText (#shared/tags); setLastMonthSpending bypasses the budget sheet's sum-amount cells.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth's `!includeHiddenCategories && (hidden || group_hidden)` re-expresses in JS the hidden rule getFillableCategories puts in its SQL; setLastMonthSpending's `amount = -amount` repeats the averages' sign flip; FIXED_TAG reimplements tag extraction as a new regex.

abstraction_drift.where: getFillableCategories gained includeHiddenCategories with a conditional SQL hidden filter; copyPreviousMonth bypasses it with its own hidden/template/#fixed checks and its own handling of the flag.
